messages.en:
{07 12 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 14 00} What's with all the
noise this early in the
morning?
{07 00 00}Yeah, yeah... {01 00 00 0f 00}Mornin' to you,
too.{01 00 00 14 00} But do you have to be
making such a racket?
{07 1b 00}Where do you get all
that energy this early,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 12 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Uhh!{01 00 00 14 00} Mis see müra
nii vara hommikul
tähendab?
{07 00 00}Jah, jah... {01 00 00 0f 00}Hommikust ka
sulle.{01 00 00 14 00} Aga kas sa pead
sellist kära tegema?
{07 1b 00}Kust sa nii vara saad
kogu selle energia,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 18 00}Go away! I don't want to
buy anything!{01 00 00 14 00} Leave me
alone, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}, it's you.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 11 00}I thought you were{01 00 00 05 00} tryin' to
sell me stuff I don't need!
messages.et:
{07 18 00}Mine ära! Ma ei taha
midagi osta!{01 00 00 14 00} Jäta mind
rahule, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}, see oled sa.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 11 00}Ma arvasin, et üritad{01 00 00 05 00} müüa
kraami, mida ma ei vaja!

messages.en:
Whoa, whoa, WHOA!{01 00 00 05 00} {07 1b 00}You don't 
have to yell, {04 1f 00}! 
I can still hear, ya know.
messages.et:
Ohoo, ohoo, OHOO!{01 00 00 05 00} {07 1b 00}Sa ei pea 
karjuma, {04 1f 00}! 
Ma kuulen veel, tead.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Heh heh{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}
Off on a little evening
mischief, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}?
{07 0d 00}Who would have thought
you'd be one I need to keep
an eye on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Heh heh{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}
Lähed väikesele õhtusele
vallatusele, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}?
{07 0d 00}Kes oleks arvanud, et
sinul pean ma silma peal
hoidma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Isn't this 
a great time of day?
{07 0d 00}Maybe I don't look like it,
but I'm really into nights
like these, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Kas pole 
suurepärane kellaaeg?
{07 0d 00}Võib-olla ma ei näe välja,
aga ma olen sellistel öödel
päris lainel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Hey, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 14 00}What are you doing out this
late?
{07 11 00}Keep at it and you're gonna
be paying for it in the
morning, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Hei, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 14 00}Mida sa nii hilja väljas
teed?
{07 11 00}Jätka nii ja sa maksad
selle eest hommikul
kinni, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 18 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Huh?{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 02 00}BLEEEARRRGGG!

{07 01 00}It's creepy enough out
here, so why do you have to
sneak up on people?!
{07 15 00}I bet you think it's
funny! ...{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 18 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Ah?{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 02 00}BLÄÄÄRGGG!

{07 01 00}Siin on niigi jube,
nii et miks sa pead
inimestele ligi hiilima?!
{07 15 00}Vean kihla, et sinu arust
on see naljakas!...{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
